content.comment_body: Good morning, I'm seeking advice. My setup includes: - a [product_name] logical module - an [product_name] analog expansion module with two 0-10V outputs - a 3-position actuator (responds to progressive 0-10V control) I want to program the [product_name] logical module so it can control the actuator to achieve three positions: - fully open - fully closed - an intermediate position corresponding to partially open (2/5 of full opening) Thank you for your assistance.

Hello, Here is the manual for your air damper actuator: [url] From what I understand (though I'm not an expert in HVAC), connect the red wire to +24V, black wire to ground, and grey wire to the output of the [product_name] analog module. Additionally, connect ground, black, and the analog module's ground together to maintain equal potentials. Operation: - Analog output at 0V ⇒ actuator is closed - Analog output at 10V ⇒ actuator is open - Analog output at 5V ⇒ actuator is halfway open There's an example made with [product_name] software [version_no]. Run the simulation, try adjusting the inputs. To alter the values, modify the analog multiplexer properties. Hope this helps.
Hello [user_name], Thanks for your instructions and the example. That will be very useful. Have a good day.
